en: The Section on Further Exposition, Chapter Fifteen: Concordance (Sampāta)
The Convergence of the Mode of Conveying Requisites:
Therein, what is the convergence of the mode of conveying requisites?
It is the verse beginning: “Therefore, for one whose mind is guarded, the range is right intention.”
This is the requisite for serenity and insight.
The section on requisites and the method of treatment is concluded.
